items.title: United Rentals CFO Sells Shares After Earnings Pop. Should Investors Follow?
items.summary: William Grace's sale reduces his direct equity stake by 20%, leaving him with $6.92 million in holdings as United Rentals trades near all-time highs.

items.title: URI Q2 Deep Dive: Large Project Demand Drives Guidance Increase and Margin Stability
items.summary: Equipment rental company United Rentals (NYSE:URI) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 11.8% year on year to $4.41 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $17.65 billion at the midpoint came in 2.2% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $12.76 per share was 10.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Otis Service Growth Builds Momentum as Equipment Demand Stays Weak
items.summary: OTIS is relying on Service growth and a rising modernization backlog to counter weak New Equipment demand as China remains a key challenge.

items.title: Is Otis Stock Attractive After Guidance Cuts and Its 19% YTD Slide?
items.summary: OTIS trades below historical valuation levels after a 19% YTD slide, but guidance cuts and margin pressure keep the investment outlook in focus.

items.title: United Rentals Q2 Earnings Call Highlights Strong Project Demand
items.summary: URI raises its 2026 outlook as large projects, record utilization and specialty growth drive stronger demand and higher fleet investment.

items.title: United Rentals Inc (URI) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Record Revenue and Raised Guidance ...

items.title: Industrial Stocks And This ETF Claw Gains From A Falling Market
items.summary: Industrial stocks bucked a falling market on Thursday. The State Street Industrial Select Sector SPDR ETF popped back into in a buy zone, led by gap-ups and breakouts for CSX, RTX and others. Many holdings in this exchange traded fund delivered blowout earnings this week.
